change.title: Change Analysis
change.excellent_text: Improved win chances while reducing loss risk with no major sector sacrifice.
change.balanced_text: Improved the team while keeping the tactical trade-off controlled.
change.risky_text: The change helps one area, but the calculated downside is noticeable.
change.not_available: Change Analysis will appear after a Workspace recalculation.

advisor.title: Tactical Advisor
advisor.empty: Tactical Advisor will appear after analysis.

use_formation.title: Use {formation} instead of {current_formation}
use_formation.explanation: This evaluated formation improves win probability by {win_delta}. Sector changes: {sector_summary}.

strongest_sector.title: {sector} is your strongest area
strongest_sector.explanation: Your calculated {sector} rating is currently {value}. No action is required there before addressing higher-risk areas.

defensive_exposure.title: {sector} is exposed
defensive_exposure.explanation: The opponent's {opponent_sector} is {gap} rating points above your matching {sector}. This is a warning until an evaluated lineup or formation change improves it.

defensive_observation.title: {sector} matchup needs attention
defensive_observation.explanation: The opponent's {opponent_sector} is ahead of your matching {sector} by {gap} rating points. Treat this as matchup context, not an unevaluated instruction.

inefficient_flank.title: {sector} is an inefficient route
inefficient_flank.explanation: Your {sector} is {gap} rating points below the opponent's matching {opponent_sector}. Do not treat this as a recommendation to strengthen it unless an evaluated change improves the result.

best_attack_matchup.title: {sector} is your best attacking route
best_attack_matchup.explanation: Your {sector} is the closest matchup against the opponent's {opponent_sector}, with a calculated margin of {gap} rating points.

low_possession.title: Possession is low
low_possession.explanation: Current possession is {possession}. This is tactical context unless an evaluated formation or lineup change increases the match result.

favorable_concentration.title: Attack concentration matches their weakness
favorable_concentration.explanation: Your strongest attacking channel, {sector}, targets the opponent's weakest matching defense, {opponent_sector}.

unfavorable_concentration.title: Attack concentration targets a stronger defense
unfavorable_concentration.explanation: Your strongest attacking channel, {sector}, targets {opponent_sector}, which is not the opponent's weakest defensive sector.

keep_lineup_change.title: Keep {incoming} in {slot}
keep_lineup_change.explanation: Replacing {outgoing} with {incoming} improved this slot and adds an estimated {win_delta} win probability.

revert_lineup_change.title: Revert {incoming} in {slot}
revert_lineup_change.explanation: Replacing {outgoing} with {incoming} reduced win probability by {win_delta}. Revert this Workspace change.

neutral_lineup_change.title: {incoming} in {slot} is neutral
neutral_lineup_change.explanation: Replacing {outgoing} with {incoming} did not create a measurable win-probability improvement. Treat it as a preference, not a recommendation.
